description: This file is a C# source code, specifically a Program.cs file configuring an ASP.NET Core web application for a data asset management system. It contains setup for services, middleware, API endpoints, authentication, authorization, Swagger (OpenAPI), database configuration, and various domain-specific resources related to assets, copy lineage, status logs, control device mappings, and more.
